content:
incident-bot: Incident declared — 2026-03-23 13:07 UTC. Ingress websocket mux rollout caused truncated streaming frames / premature EOF for some streaming clients (notably SDK v0.9.x). Symptoms: client SDKs report EOF or 502 mid-stream, partial responses. Scope: ~2% of hosted streaming sessions, concentrated in eu-west and on long-context flows. Mitigation in progress: rolled back mux config flag at 13:15 UTC. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingress-ws-truncation

sre_jamie: Rollback applied at 13:15. Early telemetry shows EOF error rate down ~87% (1200/min -> ~150/min). Still seeing residuals on connections carrying >64k token windows. Investigating connection-level logs now.

eng_nikhil: Quick RCA: mux code path + new default max-frame-size exposed a boundary-check bug in the frame assembler. Final chunk length could be mis-encoded when chunk size == max-frame-size, leading clients to see truncated frames. Patch ready (PR #4823) that tightens boundary checks and adds explicit final-frame marker handling. Adding an e2e streaming test to prevent regressions.

pm_kate: Customer impact: small set of enterprise customers using long-continuation streaming observed dropped responses / partial outputs. CS is triaging top affected accounts and drafting a joint customer note. Proposed ETA for full fix rollout: ~3 hours (canary 30m -> expand).

oncall_miguel: I kicked off staging canary for PR #4823 at 13:28 UTC. If staging telemetry is clean for 30m I'll promote to a limited prod canary, then widen. If you see noisy repeats tag @oncall_miguel. Posting status page entry: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2839012345

customer-success-ops: Reached out to three accounts already and offered immediate remediation guidance (retry logic for streaming, short-term SDK pinning to v0.8.x). SOC asked for a quick sweep for PII exposure; engineering confirmed no additional content was introduced during truncation.

incident-bot: Update 13:40 UTC — eu-west residuals reduced to ~12% of previous volume, us-west and apac back to baseline. Incident remains open for verification and staged rollout. Next update in 30m or on significant change. :thumbsup:

eng_nikhil: Temporary mitigation note for internal ops: if you must re-enable the mux flag in a pinch, set --max-frame-size=65536 and enable the legacy-boundary-compatibility toggle until PR #4823 is deployed. Not ideal long-term.

oncall_miguel: Logging pointers for triage: `ingress:ws:frame_error` tag, connection id, client sdk header `x-rw-sdk`, and `stream_tokens` metric. Example quick query: `sum(rate(ingress_ws_frame_errors_total[1m])) by (region, x_rw_sdk)`

pm_kate: Customer note draft in #customer-communications now; preparing outreach timeline. Will escalate to AE/AMs for affected customers.

incident-bot: Closing note for now: incident state = investigating -> mitigation applied. Leave open for verification until PR #4823 is canaried and widened. If you see regressions, reply here and @oncall_miguel will re-pager.
